# `pos-register` commands

## `pos-register create`

Add a POS register (a till). Turning POS on already made Main; a second register is for a second counter or device. Every field but the name has a default: the default inventory site, Undeposited Funds as the deposit account, the cash, card and check payment methods in that order, a new walk-in customer ("Walk-in (<name>)"; never shown on the POS screen or receipt), the first bank account for cash refunds, an 80 mm receipt and no shift counting. A register is not an account: its cash sits in Undeposited Funds like every other receipt. Needs pos.layout. Example: `bookflow pos-register create --name "Front counter" --receipt-width 58`. Off unless company setting pos_enabled is on (E_FEATURE_DISABLED).

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | pos.layout |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-register.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos-register create --name "Front counter" --receipt-width 58 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos-register create", "input": {"name": "Front counter", "receipt_width": 58}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site` | `--site` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Inventory site its stock leaves from (ID or name); default the default site. |
| `deposit_account` | `--deposit-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Where its takings are deposited: Undeposited Funds (the default) or a bank account (ID, number or name). |
| `payment_methods` | `--payment-methods` | array[string] \| null | no | yes | null | Payment methods it offers, in the order shown (IDs or names); default Cash, then the card and check methods. |
| `walk_in_customer` | `--walk-in-customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Customer a sale with no customer is recorded against (ID or name); never shown on the POS screen or receipt. On create, omitted: a new customer named Walk-in (Main) or "Walk-in (<register>)". |
| `refund_account` | `--refund-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Bank account cash refunds leave from (ID, number or name); default the company's first bank account; null for none yet. |
| `receipt_width` | `--receipt-width` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Receipt paper width in millimetres, 80 or 58; default 80. |
| `receipt_message` | `--receipt-message` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Line printed at the foot of every receipt; null for none. |
| `count_shifts` | `--count-shifts` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | Count the drawer in shifts (float, count, over/short); default off. |
| `decoder_order` | `--decoder-order` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Camera decoder order for this register's devices, such as "zxing-wasm,native"; null uses the host's scan_decoders. |
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Register name, such as "Front counter"; unique.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |

## `pos-register update`

Change a register under its expected version: name only what changes (name, site, deposit_account, payment_methods in order, walk_in_customer, refund_account, receipt_width 80 or 58, receipt_message, count_shifts, decoder_order). Needs pos.layout. Off unless company setting pos_enabled is on (E_FEATURE_DISABLED).

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | pos.layout |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-register.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos-register update Main --receipt-message "Thank you!" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos-register update", "input": {"pos_register": "Main", "receipt_message": "Thank you!"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site` | `--site` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Inventory site its stock leaves from (ID or name); default the default site. |
| `deposit_account` | `--deposit-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Where its takings are deposited: Undeposited Funds (the default) or a bank account (ID, number or name). |
| `payment_methods` | `--payment-methods` | array[string] \| null | no | yes | null | Payment methods it offers, in the order shown (IDs or names); default Cash, then the card and check methods. |
| `walk_in_customer` | `--walk-in-customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Customer a sale with no customer is recorded against (ID or name); never shown on the POS screen or receipt. On create, omitted: a new customer named Walk-in (Main) or "Walk-in (<register>)". |
| `refund_account` | `--refund-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Bank account cash refunds leave from (ID, number or name); default the company's first bank account; null for none yet. |
| `receipt_width` | `--receipt-width` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Receipt paper width in millimetres, 80 or 58; default 80. |
| `receipt_message` | `--receipt-message` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Line printed at the foot of every receipt; null for none. |
| `count_shifts` | `--count-shifts` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | Count the drawer in shifts (float, count, over/short); default off. |
| `decoder_order` | `--decoder-order` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Camera decoder order for this register's devices, such as "zxing-wasm,native"; null uses the host's scan_decoders. |
| `pos_register` | `POS_REGISTER` | string | yes | no | — | Register ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New name. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos-register.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `site` | object | yes | no | — | — |
| `site.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `site.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `deposit_account` | object | yes | no | — | — |
| `deposit_account.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `deposit_account.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_methods` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_methods[].id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_methods[].name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `payment_methods[].kind` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `walk_in_customer` | object | yes | no | — | The customer a sale with no customer is recorded against. |
| `walk_in_customer.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `walk_in_customer.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `refund_account` | object \| null | yes | yes | — | Bank account cash refunds leave from; null until one is set. |
| `refund_account.id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `refund_account.name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `receipt_width` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `receipt_message` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `count_shifts` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `decoder_order` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `warnings` | array[string] | no | no | [] | What needs attention: a record it points at that is no longer active, or no refund account yet. |
| `changed` | boolean | no | no | true | — |
| `created_walk_in_customer` | boolean | no | no | false | True when this call made the walk-in customer. |

Example JSON output:

{
  "changed": true,
  "count_shifts": false,
  "created_walk_in_customer": false,
  "decoder_order": null,
  "deposit_account": {
    "id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
    "name": "value"
  },

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_INACTIVE` | That directive has been deactivated. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND` | No such directive. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` | That idempotency key was used for a different command or input. |
| `E_INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | A new or changed reference must name an active record. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NAME_TAKEN` | That display name is already used. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VERSION_CONFLICT` | The record changed since the version you read. |
